svg.title: Two floors on the finished sheet
svg.desc: Excel rows of the finished file: framing list of the first floor, a porch block of that floor, walls of the first floor, then framing list of the second floor, a balcony block with its decking and railing subsection, and walls of the second floor. Notes on the right explain each kind of row.
